findings.summary: The six evidence obligations (the spec's core deliverable 'gate 必答字段, 引擎侧机械履行') are delivered only as an orphaned module: fleet_graph/selfgate.py is imported by no production module, require_gate_evidence/missing_gate_evidence are invoked nowhere outside tests, and decision_deliver/_deliver_dd accept no evidence payload and never refuse a delivery for missing evidence. This is exactly the 'imported by no production module / exported but never invoked' defect approved.md:30 says continuous_review rejected twice, with the explicit instruction '别只交模块'.

Spec item 1 (线自判路径成引擎默认: goal line performs the six obligations on dd_awaiting_gate wake, then delivers via evidence-checked decision_deliver, decided_by==dispatched_by) is not wired: there is no production path that mechanically performs or enforces the six obligations, so the negative criterion '线漏掉任一项取证义务就投递 → 投递被拒' has no red-able engine path (the only red test is a direct unit call to require_gate_evidence({})).

Spec item 4 (取证与结论落档 as the decision_deliver rationale 载荷) is undelivered: the delivery result and its ledger entry embed no evidence digest/rationale, contradicting selfgate.py's own docstring claim that it 'produces the evidence payload that delivery embeds as its rationale'.
Spec item 5 (收割反应器改接 merge 段之后: move the harvest trigger from 'after gate' to 'after merge', allowlist = release/<line-id> 可写仓) is undelivered; no change moves the harvest reactor trigger point.
